summary: Edit Student feature end-to-end verified. BACKEND: 10/10 pytest cases pass on PATCH /api/admin/students/{id} - partial update + trim, Type switch, extra fields (admission_no/id/approved) ignored, 400 for empty body / phone='123' / whatsapp invalid / email 'bad' / full_name empty, 422 for type='Other', 404 for unknown id, GET /api/students/{id} reflects update. FRONTEND (390x844): seeded student 'Edit UI User' (TEDIT-UI-001). Admin login ok; tapping row opens student-detail-sheet; both student-sheet-edit (pencil) and student-sheet-edit-btn switch to student-edit-form with prefilled values. Changing full_name/class/phone + edit-save returns to detail view with edit-saved banner (verified visible immediately after save), updated student-sheet-name and detail rows (SY-B / 6666666666). Closing sheet, list row shows updated name/class/phone. Switching to Workshop via edit-type-workshop and saving: tag in sheet changes to Workshop and type-filter-workshop count went 1 -> 2. Validations: phone '123' -> 'Phone must be 10 digits'; empty name -> 'Full name is required'; email 'bad' -> 'Valid email required'. edit-cancel discards changes (original email edit.ui@example.com preserved in detail view). GET /api/students/{id} (My Pass source) returns updated values. Test data cleaned up (student + admission deleted).

issues: edit-save / edit-cancel buttons sit at the bottom of the ScrollView; on 390x844 viewport they require scrolling into view. User on physical device will scroll naturally, so this is minor UX only - no fix needed.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend PATCH endpoint cleanly validates each updatable field with trim + per-field rules; Pydantic Literal rejects unknown type with 422 as spec'd. Extra keys (admission_no/id/approved) are correctly ignored because they are not in StudentUpdate.

StudentDetailSheet uses setForm(toForm(s)) on cancel and resets edit mode flags properly; save path diffs form against original before PATCH, so an unchanged save short-circuits without hitting backend.
No admin auth guard on PATCH /api/admin/students/{id} (same as other /admin/* endpoints) - consistent with existing pattern, not a regression.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest uses TEST_EDIT_001 admission + 'Edit Test User' student (fixture cleanup). Frontend used TEDIT-UI-001 + 'Edit UI User' (cleaned via DELETE /api/admin/students/{id} and DELETE /api/admin/admissions/TEDIT-UI-001).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin creds admin/Kacc@8131. 3 baseline students remain (Test Student / Test Student E2E / QA Student) plus 1 pre-existing Workshop student. PATCH endpoint and Edit Student UI are stable. Run /app/backend/tests/test_edit_student.py for regression.
